messages.content: You are a precise biomedical information extraction assistant. Follow the requested output format exactly and never add explanations.

Given the following text and a relational triplet extracted from it:

Text: Is sertraline the same as Zoloft?
:
Yes.
Sertraline is the active ingredient.
Zoloft is the brand name Sertraline is sold under in the United States.
Sertraline is the generic version of Zoloft.
The two contain the same medicine, sertraline hydrochloride.
You may also see sertraline written as sertraline HCl.
Is sertraline an SSRI, and how does sertraline work?
:
Yes, sertraline is an SSRI, which stands for selective serotonin reuptake inhibitor.
Nerve cells in the brain release serotonin to send signals.
Then, they reabsorb serotonin.
Sertraline blocks that reabsorption.
More serotonin stays available between nerve cells.
Sertraline has very little effect on norepinephrine.
Sertraline has very little effect on dopamine.
Sertraline has no meaningful effect on adrenergic receptors.
Sertraline has no meaningful effect on cholinergic receptors.
Sertraline has no meaningful effect on GABA receptors.
Sertraline has no meaningful effect on histamine receptors.
Sertraline has no meaningful effect on benzodiazepine receptors.
Triplet: ["Zoloft", "is brand name of", "sertraline"]

The relation 'is brand name of' in the triplet is defined as 'The subject drug is the commercial brand name under which the object drug is marketed.' In this context, is there any relation appropriate to replace it? Choose a relation whose meaning and subject/object direction match the triplet even if the wording differs; choose 'None of the above' only if no candidate fits. Please answer by providing only the letter of your choice.

Choices:
A. 'has brand name': The subject drug is marketed under the brand or trade name specified by the object entity.
B. 'manufactured by': The subject drug is manufactured or marketed by the company specified by the object entity.
C. 'has multiple brands and forms': The subject drug is available in multiple brands and forms as specified by the object entity.
D. 'is active form of': The subject drug is the active, ready-to-use form of the object drug.
E. 'has generic name': The subject drug is sold under or known by the generic (non-proprietary) name specified by the object entity.
F. None of the above.
